query: What LA‑Sn calibration strategies (matrix‑matched standards, synthetic alloys) exist or must be developed, and what are contingency workflows when Sn is near LA detection limits?

response.query: What LA‑Sn calibration strategies (matrix‑matched standards, synthetic alloys) exist or must be developed, and what are contingency workflows when Sn is near LA detection limits?
response.answer: LA-Sn calibration uses matrix-matched standards and synthetic alloys; contingency workflows involve spike-and-recovery methods when Sn nears LA detection limits.

results.title: Hydrogen Embrittlement as a Conspicuous Material ...
results.content: HE is the key threat to the structural integrity of metallic materials in green H applications.5−7 Being the smallest atom in the universe, H can adsorb on the surface, diffuse into the bulk, and distribute heterogeneously in and interact with the microstructure of a metal, which can severely undermine the strength, ductility, and fracture toughness.8 HE affects nearly all engineering alloys employed in green H transport and storage systems, e.g., ferritic steels,9,10 austenitic stainless steels,11,12 nickel alloys,13−15 aluminum alloys,16 and titanium alloys.17−19 The impact of H extends beyond fracture characteristics to include elasticity, strain hardening, and fatigue life. Machine learning force field for Fe-H system and investigation on role of hydrogen on the crack propagation in α-Fe.
